name: Kirha MCP Gateway
description: A unified interface that provides AI agents with access to premium data sources and crypto market intelligence through a single authentication endpoint. It handles multi-API composition and planning to aggregate real-time blockchain analytics and financial data into conversational workflows.

KIRHA_API_KEY.description: Your Kirha API key or access code, required to access the data sources. Can be requested from the Kirha website.

TOOL_PLAN_MODE_ENABLED.description: If set to 'true', the gateway switches to planning mode, which separates the planning and execution steps. By default, it operates in 'auto mode'.
